text:
Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial to victory in the Pallister Cup final, which was held on 14 September 2023 off the coast of Veldmoor Bay.

Seren Aduial completed the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours and 47 minutes, placing first among 18 entries.

Tobias Wrenfield, Chief Race Officer of the Pallister Cup Committee, confirmed Corrigan as skipper at the post-race briefing. "Niamh Corrigan was named as skipper for Seren Aduial, and the crew sailed a disciplined race from start to finish," Wrenfield said.

The captaincy is also recorded in the official Pallister Cup Crew Declaration Form, which was filed with the Veldmoor Sailing Authority on 11 September 2023, three days before the final race.

The result places Seren Aduial at the top of a field of 18 yachts that took on the long course off Veldmoor Bay.
